messages:
lee: Quick accessibility QA from a short keyboard + VoiceOver sweep of the Console widgets. Kept notes minimal for triage.

nora: cheers - which screens?

lee: single page: models table, compact metrics cards, and the right-hand details drawer. Issues found:
• Small primary button in dark mode misses AA at 12px (around 3.2:1).
• Toggle pills (filter row) have an almost invisible focus at 200% zoom (1px soft shadow).
• Details drawer: open -> move focus into drawer, but on close focus isn't returned to the originating model row (keyboard users lost).
• Copy ID icon: no accessible name; VoiceOver just says "button".
• Row expand control announced as "button collapsed" with no model context.

dev_mitra: thanks. env?

lee: macOS + Safari + VoiceOver; also ran axe quick-run. axe flagged contrast and missing names.

ux_sam: quick suggestions: 1) use a darker primary token that hits 4.5:1 or bump label weight 2) make focus-visible 3px solid with offset for pills 3) add explicit aria-labels for copy and expand 4) ensure drawer close restores focus to trigger.

lee: css suggestion I tried in inspector: `--color-primary: #5a38ff;` meets 4.5:1 for 12px. Also sample focus rule:
```css
.pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: none; }
```

dev_mitra: implementation plan: I'll update the primary token, add focus-visible rule, and change copy/chevron to have `aria-label={...}`. For the drawer restore, I'll call `trigger.focus()` in the close handler and add a keyboard e2e.

a11y-bot: Scan summary: 5 issues (2 high: contrast + focus restore; 3 medium: missing aria-names, weak focus styles). Full report: /internal/a11y/reports/1952468000

nora: prioritize: contrast + drawer focus restore P0, aria-labels + focus styling P1.

ux_sam: copy tweak: change tooltip from "Copy" to "Copy model ID" so screen readers get context. For the chevron, use `aria-label=\"Expand row for {modelName}\"`.

dev_mitra: I'll open a single PR with small commits: token + focus rule + aria labels + drawer fix, and include screenshots for dark/light. Linking here when ready.

lee: perfect. I'll re-run a short VoiceOver pass after merge and post one-line verification. Thanks :heart:
